article_limitations: Case-series cohort of eight participants; participant-level data come from Tables 1 and 2 only. Table 3, the Mean±SD row, group statistics and adverse-event counts are aggregate and are not copied to individuals.

Adverse events (two shoulder soreness, two tachycardia, one participant missed a week of training) and tachycardia noted by primary care providers before the study are not attributed to any participant in the text; not assigned.
Source statement that all participants were satisfied is cohort-level; Table 2 lists No for P2 Q1 and P8 Q3, and P4 did not complete the survey; no cohort satisfaction was copied to individuals.

Footnote limits some Table 3 data to four participants (P3, P5, P6, P7) because of aberrant gas detections, which by elimination excludes P2 from those rows; no individual Table 3 values are reported, so no measurement fact was assigned.

Eligibility criteria (adult, manual wheelchair use) are stated for participants generally and were not copied to individuals; one withdrawn participant and one excluded participant are not among the eight.

Figure 2 has eight unlabelled subplots titled with sex, level and adherence; six titles match exactly one Table 1 row, the two F - T12 subplots (P1, P2) cannot be told apart. The M - T10 subplot (P7) prints 98% adherance against 100% in Table 1: P7 adherence quarantined as source_conflict with an ambiguity; no panel labels invented.

Figure 1A prints a 5 min cool-down label while the text states a three-minute cooldown and the plotted cool-down segment itself spans 21 to 24 minutes; the schematic is an example, not participant data, so the text prescription is retained and only noted here.
Supplement SD1 ZIP holds a blank SCI Exercise Self-Efficacy Scale form and a STROBE checklist; no patient-level data.

Figure 3 caption gives n=338 attempted workouts while the results text describes an average of 253 training intervals (Table 1 session counts sum to 343); cohort-level counts, not reconciled and not assigned to participants.
Table 1 P6 lists 48 training sessions with 81% adherence, inconsistent with the footnote definition of adherence; both cells quarantined as source_conflict.
SCI ESES self-efficacy scores (three time points) and weekly adverse-event surveys are reported only as cohort statistics; no participant-level values exist, so nothing was assigned.
